title: Unexpected Gratitude - Chof Tes Elul, Birthday of the Tzemach Tzedek

article.body:
The Story Lives On: When the Tzemach Tzedek was still a baby, his nurse did something nice for him. Years later, the Tzemach Tzedek found a way to repay her.

Do you show Hakaras Hatov for all the many nice things people do for you?

Complete your 29 Elul missions
